text: One painting of this mythological figure depicts him dressed in orange and green and clutching his breast, and was painted by one of the Le Nain brothers. A drawing of Saint John the Baptist pointing with his right hand and clutching a staff was painted over to look like this figure; that painting is often attributed to Leonardo. Diego Velasquez painted the Triumph of this figure for Philip IV; that painting depicts this god with seven Spanish peasants. Probably the most famous depiction of him shows him with a half- bared chest next to a basket of fruit and is by the artist of The Calling of Saint Matthew.
